GreedyLR is an adaptive learning rate scheduler recently added to Hugging Face Transformers. This differs from traditional schedulers like cosine annealing by responding to actual training dynamics rather than following a predetermined schedule.

It raises the learning rate by dividing it by factor when the metric keeps improving, and lowers the learning rate by multiplying it by factor when the metric doesn't improve.
